planning_basis: R03 remains completed and R04 remains the single active phase. README commit 5d83627a26696c10d180cdd75f357c3e9c39cde7, authorized by Admin #265, defines deterministic SEED-backed character identity, campaign-time aging, birthplace/formative baseline influence, current-location contextual effects, dynamic emotion/mood, delta-based character persistence and one shared Local BOT/LLM character truth. Planner #266 decomposes the R04 fundamentals into #267-#272, preserves existing livelihood #258-#262 and all compatible verified work, and pre-decomposes #273 for blocked R05 dialogue integration and #274 for blocked R06 long-lived memory/relationship emotional consequences.

planner_capacity_policy.target_open_focused_work_issues: 45-55 when legitimate approved scope supports it
planner_capacity_policy.target_immediately_eligible_unclaimed: >=10 when legitimate dependencies and scope permit
planner_capacity_policy.current_priority: Current and earlier unresolved active work always outranks dependency-blocked future work.
planner_capacity_policy.future_predecomposition: README/ROADMAP-defined near-future work may be pre-decomposed only when useful and must remain blocked until phase/dependencies are eligible.
planner_capacity_policy.anti_filler: Never invent features/gameplay, duplicate scope, or create filler merely to satisfy capacity.

core_rule: Player advises -> AI Character decides -> Simulation validates -> World reacts.

baseline.public_policy: Normal verified status requires independent Tester evidence except the documented cumulative Tester deadlock exception.

phase_policy.origin_rule: Every new campaign begins at authoritative world coordinate (0,0) in the SEED-generated inhabited starting village.
phase_policy.region_size_rule: One normal logical/thematic region is exactly 100x100 tiles while the overall SEED world remains continuous and unbounded.
phase_policy.local_tile_presentation_rule: Local play converges to a readable classic tile-based 2D/2.5D RPG presentation with enterable buildings and world-space character sprites.
phase_policy.enterable_building_rule: Accessible local buildings are physical parts of the same authoritative world with walls, walkable floors, usable entrances, rooms and function-appropriate interior anchors.
phase_policy.interior_continuity_rule: Entering a building refines the same authoritative building/location; interiors may be lazy/streamed but are not duplicate scenes.
phase_policy.world_space_sprite_rule: Gameplay-relevant local characters converge to transparent PNG sprites anchored to authoritative positions/tiles; detached markers are transitional only.
phase_policy.npc_tile_occupancy_rule: Active NPC logical-tile occupancy is exclusive and conflicts resolve deterministically; direct NPC dialogue uses adjacent tiles.
phase_policy.advisor_chat_r04_rule: R04 retains the accepted minimum free-text Advisor conversation/non-binding Local BOT influence chain before gate #178.
phase_policy.real_time_rule: At normal speed 60 real-world minutes equal one 24-hour in-game day.
phase_policy.calendar_continuity_rule: Birth dates, ages, schedules and other time-dependent character/world state use authoritative accelerated fantasy campaign chronology.
phase_policy.deterministic_character_identity_rule: Compatible SEED plus stable character/world identity inputs reproduce the same unchanged character base identity across materialization and region transitions.
phase_policy.character_base_fields_rule: Deterministic base identity includes stable name, gender, birth date, birthplace, baseline personality/behavior and base profession/social-role inputs where applicable.
phase_policy.character_age_rule: Current age derives from birth date plus authoritative campaign time; life-stage effects may influence behavior/emotion without replacing baseline personality.
phase_policy.birthplace_baseline_rule: Birthplace/formative culture, geography and conditions may create enduring baseline tendencies such as courage, caution, sociability, resilience or environmental familiarity.
phase_policy.current_location_context_rule: Current location and events create contextual/temporary or evolving effects such as morale, stress, fear or hope; they do not overwrite baseline identity.
phase_policy.emotional_state_rule: Protagonist and NPCs may have dynamic mood/emotional state influenced by simulation-backed events, needs, relationships, memories, age/life stage and current conditions.
phase_policy.emotion_authority_rule: Emotion biases preferences, social behavior, dialogue tone, advice interpretation and later choices but never makes impossible actions legal or overrides Simulation truth.
phase_policy.character_persistence_delta_rule: Unchanged deterministic character foundations may be regenerated; meaningful campaign departures/history persist as authoritative deltas where required.
phase_policy.driver_character_truth_rule: Deterministic Local BOT and optional LLM consume the same Simulation-backed identity, personality, age, relationships, memories and emotional context.
phase_policy.resident_transient_rule: Persistent local residents normally have valid homes; explicitly transient visitors may enter, work/trade and leave without invented residences.
phase_policy.profession_workplace_rule: Working characters use profession-compatible indoor workplaces or typed outdoor worksites; multiple compatible NPCs may share one workplace.
phase_policy.outdoor_worksite_rule: Farmers, hunters, fishers and other outdoor workers use deterministic terrain-appropriate reachable worksites rather than fake buildings or blocked tiles.
phase_policy.guard_shift_rule: Settlement entrance/exit guards may rotate through time-aware shifts using valid guard-post/barracks/home relationships without occupancy or route deadlocks.
phase_policy.pathfinding_rule: NPC travel must remain compatible with authoritative terrain walkability, road/path preference, building entrances and collision-safe occupancy.
phase_policy.relevance_bounded_character_rule: Distant/irrelevant characters do not require continuous full-detail emotion/routine ticking; compact state/history may be reconciled lazily without changing causal truth.
phase_policy.device_performance_rule: Desktop, phone and tablet are gameplay targets; fidelity may scale but authoritative character/world outcomes may not.
phase_policy.designer_rule: Every phase requires at least one independently testable Designer-role task before normal phase completion.
phase_policy.tester_deadlock_rule: Normal phase/release verification uses an independent Worker; only the documented cumulative deadlock exception permits DEADLOCK TESTER PASS.
phase_policy.normal_phase_transition_rule: R05 does not activate until R04 gate #178 passes under the normal or documented deadlock path.

Current location replacing birthplace-derived baseline personality

Local BOT and LLM using conflicting underlying character identity/state
Persisting presentation-only character facts as Simulation authority
Continuous full-detail emotional ticking of every irrelevant character in the unbounded world
